hooks.command: IN=$(cat); R=$(ls -d "$HOME"/.codex/plugins/cache/xtrace-plugins/memhub/*/ 2>/dev/null | sort -V | while IFS= read -r d; do [ -f "$d/scripts/codex_flush.py" ] && printf '%s\n' "$d"; done | tail -1); P=$(command -v python3 || command -v python); if [ -z "$P" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/memhub-plugin/codexflush" 2>/dev/null && printf "%s [codex-flush] no python3/python on PATH - capture skipped\n" "$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)" >> "$HOME/.config/memhub-plugin/codexflush/log"; elif [ -n "$R" ]; then T=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/memhub-codex-hook.XXXXXX") || exit 0; printf %s "$IN" > "$T"; nohup sh -c '"$3" "${1%/}/scripts/codex_flush.py" Stop < "$2"; rm -f "$2"' -- "$R" "$T" "$P" >/dev/null 2>&1 & fi
